title: How to Delete Your ChatGPT Data (and Stop It Training on Your Chats)
description:
How to stop ChatGPT training on your chats — turn off model training, delete your chat history, export your data and switch off personalised marketing in 30 seconds.

Honestly, most people never open this settings page. Settings → Data controls is where it all lives.

Follow for more AI tips without the overwhelm.

#chatgpt #aiprivacy #dataprivacy #claude #claudeai
